correctness.rationale: The orthonormal Krawtchouk eigenbasis gives the cubic site-3 vanishing criterion; square/parity arithmetic counts every root, contractivity rules out extra nondecaying Jordan components; projection and local binomial CLT give exact survival and three asymptotic constants. The quadratic site-2 polynomial has no common zero, proving complete eventual absorption for any two positive sink strengths, and first-order analytic eigenvalue perturbation gives the exact linewidth coefficients. Independent numerical diagonalization and symbolic integer enumeration reproduce finite cases.

value.rationale: Detector placement in an engineered perfect-transfer chain has an unexpected size-arithmetic effect, with a complete four-case dark-dimension classification and three sharply different large-size endpoint survival profiles. An adjacent detector always eliminates trapping; calculated secondary-loss linewidths quantify the physical cost in metastable lifetime. These results directly address robust site-resolved coherent transport rather than an arbitrary unmotivated invariant.
